meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.valeur: environ 100 points de base en dessous de la croissance pondérée moyenne de sa catégorie
guidances.citation: The company continues to expect 2026 Organic Sales Growth to be approximately 100 basis points below its weighted average category growth in the categories and countries it competes, which is approximately 1.7 percent on a trailing twelve-month basis.
Adjusted Operating Profit is expected to grow mid-single digits on a constant-currency basis.

guidances.libelle: Croissance du bénéfice par action ajusté des activités poursuivies
guidances.citation: Adjusted Earnings Per Share from Continuing Operations are expected to grow high single digits on a constant-currency basis.

guidances.libelle: Évolution du bénéfice par action ajusté attribuable à Kimberly-Clark
guidances.citation: Adjusted Earnings Per Share Attributable to Kimberly-Clark are expected to see a low single digit decline on a constant-currency basis.
